A_Avalanche.Desc: Howls from the mountain: a snowball rolls, grows and buries the target.
A_Avalanche.Name: Avalanche

A_BalloonBarrage.Desc: Inflates three balloons and lobs them around the target; they splash and leave a puddle.
A_BalloonBarrage.Name: Water Balloons

A_BeeSwarm.Desc: Buzzes and releases a swarm that chases the target and ends with a sting.
A_BeeSwarm.Name: Bee Swarm

A_CactusVolley.Desc: Puffs up and fires fans of spikes; the ones that land keep stabbing.
A_CactusVolley.Name: Spike Volley

A_CorgiBounce.Desc: Jumps backwards and butt-slams the target; the ground ripples in waves.
A_CorgiBounce.Name: Butt Bounce

A_Frisbee.Desc: Throws a frisbee that curves around the target, then leaps over it to catch it midair.
A_Frisbee.Name: Perfect Frisbee

A_GuardianStance.Desc: Plants its paws behind a golden shield (less damage) and strikes back with a ground stomp.
A_GuardianStance.Name: Guardian Stance

A_K9Takedown.Desc: Sniffs, locks on to the target, leaps and pins it down with bites.
A_K9Takedown.Name: K9 Takedown

A_SausageRoll.Desc: Curls up like a wheel, rolls through the target and comes back like a boomerang.
A_SausageRoll.Name: Sausage Roll

A_ScentHowl.Desc: Sniffs the trail to the target, dashes at it and lets out a hunting howl that pushes back.
A_ScentHowl.Name: Hunter's Nose

A_Slipstream.Desc: Marks a track, dashes straight through the target and the slipstream cuts everything in its path.
A_Slipstream.Name: Slipstream

A_SporeBurst.Desc: Its cap puffs up and releases spores that make the target doze off.
A_SporeBurst.Name: Sleepy Spores

A_WindUpRush.Desc: Winds the key on its back and zigzags around, slamming into the target.
A_WindUpRush.Name: Wind-Up Rush

A_YapBlast.Desc: Shakes with rage and barks in a cone that pushes back and stuns.
A_YapBlast.Name: Yap Blast

B_AnchorHook.Desc: Spins the anchor, hurls it at the target, reels it back and smashes it into the ground.
B_AnchorHook.Name: Captain's Anchor

B_ArcaneOrbs.Desc: Three orbs spin, fly at the target and a magic seal opens beneath it and explodes.
B_ArcaneOrbs.Name: Arcane Orbs

B_Avalanche.Desc: Lifts a giant snowball and throws it: it explodes and freezes.
B_Avalanche.Name: Avalanche

B_BassDrop.Desc: Three sound beats push the target back and the final DROP stuns the area.
B_BassDrop.Name: Bass Drop

B_InkTentacles.Desc: Spits blinding ink, tentacles burst from the ground, squeeze the target and slam it down.
B_InkTentacles.Name: Ink & Tentacles

B_LunarFrenzy.Desc: Howls at the moon, attacks with life-stealing claws and finishes with an uppercut.
B_LunarFrenzy.Name: Lunar Fury

B_RocketBarrage.Desc: Fires up its jetpack, flies up and launches curving rockets at the target.
B_RocketBarrage.Name: Rocket Rain

B_RollingBall.Desc: Curls into an armored ball, bounces on the target again and again and cracks the ground.
B_RollingBall.Name: Armored Ball

B_SaberMaul.Desc: A paralyzing roar, a pounce, X-claws and a saber bite that makes it bleed.
B_SaberMaul.Name: Saber Fury

B_ShieldLance.Desc: Raises its shield (blocks damage) and counters with lance thrusts.
B_ShieldLance.Name: Shield & Lance

B_Stinger.Desc: Raises its tail and stings three times; the target is poisoned and slowed.
B_Stinger.Name: Stinger

B_TankShell.Desc: Aims with a laser, fires a huge shell (recoil!) and sets the ground on fire.
B_TankShell.Name: Heavy Artillery

B_VineSnare.Desc: Vines trap the target; the plant head chomps it and leaves an acid puddle.
B_VineSnare.Name: Flytrap Snap

BoneToss.Desc: Throws bones that fly back, hitting everything on the way.
BoneToss.Name: Boomerang Bone

C_BoneCage.Desc: Falls apart into a pile of bones, rebuilds under the target and a giant rib cage bursts from the ground and snaps shut on it.
C_BoneCage.Name: Bone Cage

C_CrystalPrison.Desc: Punches the ground and a giant crystal traps the target; the golem leaps and shatters the prison with its body.
C_CrystalPrison.Name: Crystal Prison

C_EventHorizon.Desc: The pup becomes a black hole: it sucks in the target, grinds it in orbit and spits it far away through a white hole.
C_EventHorizon.Name: Event Horizon

C_FlyingBlades.Desc: The four katanas fly from its demon arms, spin around the target slicing, then return for a final X slash.
C_FlyingBlades.Name: Oni Blades

C_GlacialRebirth.Desc: Turns into an invulnerable ice egg and heals; the egg cracks and bursts into a freezing storm of ice feathers.
C_GlacialRebirth.Name: Glacial Rebirth

C_HydraFrenzy.Desc: All five heads stretch like snakes and bite from five sides. Every bite that lands restores HP.
C_HydraFrenzy.Name: Hydra Frenzy

C_Judgement.Desc: Spreads its six wings, six pillars of light surround the target, sweep to the center and become a holy column. Heals a little.
C_Judgement.Name: Divine Judgement

C_KrakenGrab.Desc: Giant tentacles burst from the ground, grab the target, lift it up and smash it down. Ends with a blast of ink.
C_KrakenGrab.Name: Kraken Grab

C_MissileBarrage.Desc: Opens its pods and fires 12 homing missiles that rise and rain down on the target; ends with a cannon blast.
C_MissileBarrage.Name: Missile Barrage

C_MoonFall.Desc: The moon leaves orbit, grows in the sky and crashes onto the target, leaving a crater; its rings become a shockwave.
C_MoonFall.Name: Moonfall

C_RainbowBridge.Desc: A rainbow forms in the sky, it gallops across it and lands horn-first on the target in a burst of color.
C_RainbowBridge.Name: Rainbow Bridge

C_ThunderWall.Desc: The cloud on its back zaps it; with every stomp a wall of lightning marches across the ground to the target.
C_ThunderWall.Name: Thunder Wall

C_TimeStop.Desc: A giant clock appears in the sky and time stops. It strikes the frozen target from every side and everything explodes when time resumes.
C_TimeStop.Name: Time Stop

Charge.Desc: Lowers its head and rams the target with knockback.
Charge.Name: Charge

CrystalSpikes.Desc: Crystals burst from the ground in a line to the target.
CrystalSpikes.Name: Crystal Spikes

D_SunfireBreath.Desc: Breathes a sweeping beam of golden sunfire that burns everything in front, then a small sun explodes on the target and heals you.
D_SunfireBreath.Name: Sunfire Breath

DoubleAssault.Desc: The heads take turns attacking, then finish with a double bite.
DoubleAssault.Name: Double Assault

DragonBreath.Desc: Backs up, breathes a cone of fire and finishes with a tail strike.
DragonBreath.Name: Dragon Breath

El_Earth_Beam.Desc: Fires a long beam and stuns.
El_Earth_Beam.Name: Stone Beam

El_Earth_Bolt.Desc: Spits a ball that explodes on the target and stuns.
El_Earth_Bolt.Name: Stone Bolt

El_Earth_Rain.Desc: Makes it rain from the sky around the target and stuns.
El_Earth_Rain.Name: Stone Rain

El_Earth_Rush.Desc: Dashes into the target and explodes and stuns.
El_Earth_Rush.Name: Stone Rush

El_Earth_Slam.Desc: Jumps high and slams the ground and stuns.
El_Earth_Slam.Name: Stone Slam

El_Earth_Volley.Desc: Shoots three balls in a fan and stuns.
El_Earth_Volley.Name: Stone Volley

El_Earth_Vortex.Desc: A vortex pulls enemies in and hurts them and stuns.
El_Earth_Vortex.Name: Stone Vortex

El_Fire_Beam.Desc: Fires a long beam and burns.
El_Fire_Beam.Name: Flame Beam

El_Fire_Bolt.Desc: Spits a ball that explodes on the target and burns.
El_Fire_Bolt.Name: Flame Bolt

El_Fire_Rain.Desc: Makes it rain from the sky around the target and burns.
El_Fire_Rain.Name: Flame Rain

El_Fire_Rush.Desc: Dashes into the target and explodes and burns.

El_Fire_Slam.Desc: Jumps high and slams the ground and burns.
El_Fire_Slam.Name: Flame Slam

El_Fire_Volley.Desc: Shoots three balls in a fan and burns.
El_Fire_Volley.Name: Flame Volley

El_Fire_Vortex.Desc: A vortex pulls enemies in and hurts them and burns.
El_Fire_Vortex.Name: Flame Vortex

El_Fly_Beam.Desc: Fires a long beam and strikes again from the sky.
El_Fly_Beam.Name: Sky Beam

El_Fly_Bolt.Desc: Spits a ball that explodes on the target and strikes again from the sky.
El_Fly_Bolt.Name: Sky Bolt

El_Fly_Nova.Desc: Blasts everything around and strikes again from the sky.

El_Fly_Rush.Name: Sky Rush

El_Fly_Slam.Desc: Jumps high and slams the ground and strikes again from the sky.
El_Fly_Slam.Name: Sky Slam

El_Fly_Volley.Desc: Shoots three balls in a fan and strikes again from the sky.
El_Fly_Volley.Name: Sky Volley

El_Fly_Vortex.Desc: A vortex pulls enemies in and hurts them and strikes again from the sky.
El_Fly_Vortex.Name: Sky Vortex

El_Ice_Volley.Desc: Shoots three balls in a fan and freezes.
El_Ice_Volley.Name: Frost Volley

El_Ice_Vortex.Desc: A vortex pulls enemies in and hurts them and freezes.
El_Ice_Vortex.Name: Frost Vortex

El_Light_Beam.Name: Holy Beam

El_Light_Bolt.Desc: Spits a ball that explodes on the target and heals you.

El_Light_Vortex.Desc: A vortex pulls enemies in and hurts them and heals you.

El_Nature_Rain.Name: Wild Rain

El_Nature_Rush.Desc: Dashes into the target and explodes and roots enemies in vines and heals you.
El_Nature_Rush.Name: Wild Rush

El_Nature_Slam.Desc: Jumps high and slams the ground and roots enemies in vines and heals you.
El_Nature_Slam.Name: Wild Slam

El_Poison_Volley.Name: Toxic Volley

El_Poison_Vortex.Desc: A vortex pulls enemies in and hurts them and poisons.
El_Poison_Vortex.Name: Toxic Vortex

El_Shadow_Beam.Desc: Fires a long beam and always lands a critical hit.
El_Shadow_Beam.Name: Shadow Beam

El_Shadow_Bolt.Desc: Spits a ball that explodes on the target and always lands a critical hit.
El_Shadow_Bolt.Name: Shadow Bolt

El_Shadow_Nova.Desc: Blasts everything around and always lands a critical hit.
El_Shadow_Nova.Name: Shadow Nova

El_Shadow_Rain.Desc: Makes it rain from the sky around the target and always lands a critical hit.
El_Shadow_Rain.Name: Shadow Rain

El_Shadow_Rush.Desc: Dashes into the target and explodes and always lands a critical hit.
El_Shadow_Rush.Name: Shadow Rush

El_Shadow_Slam.Desc: Jumps high and slams the ground and always lands a critical hit.
El_Shadow_Slam.Name: Shadow Slam

El_Shadow_Volley.Desc: Shoots three balls in a fan and always lands a critical hit.
El_Shadow_Volley.Name: Shadow Volley

El_Shadow_Vortex.Desc: A vortex pulls enemies in and hurts them and always lands a critical hit.
El_Shadow_Vortex.Name: Shadow Vortex

El_Thunder_Beam.Desc: Fires a long beam and strikes twice with lightning.
El_Thunder_Beam.Name: Thunder Beam

El_Thunder_Bolt.Desc: Spits a ball that explodes on the target and strikes twice with lightning.
El_Thunder_Bolt.Name: Thunder Bolt

El_Thunder_Nova.Desc: Blasts everything around and strikes twice with lightning.
El_Thunder_Nova.Name: Thunder Nova

El_Thunder_Rain.Desc: Makes it rain from the sky around the target and strikes twice with lightning.
El_Thunder_Rain.Name: Thunder Rain

El_Thunder_Rush.Desc: Dashes into the target and explodes and strikes twice with lightning.
El_Thunder_Rush.Name: Thunder Rush

El_Thunder_Slam.Desc: Jumps high and slams the ground and strikes twice with lightning.
El_Thunder_Slam.Name: Thunder Slam

El_Thunder_Volley.Desc: Shoots three balls in a fan and strikes twice with lightning.
El_Thunder_Volley.Name: Thunder Volley

El_Thunder_Vortex.Desc: A vortex pulls enemies in and hurts them and strikes twice with lightning.
El_Thunder_Vortex.Name: Thunder Vortex

El_Water_Beam.Desc: Fires a long beam and launches into the air.
El_Water_Beam.Name: Tidal Beam

El_Water_Bolt.Desc: Spits a ball that explodes on the target and launches into the air.
El_Water_Bolt.Name: Tidal Bolt

El_Water_Nova.Desc: Blasts everything around and launches into the air.
El_Water_Nova.Name: Tidal Nova

El_Water_Rain.Desc: Makes it rain from the sky around the target and launches into the air.
El_Water_Rain.Name: Tidal Rain

El_Water_Rush.Desc: Dashes into the target and explodes and launches into the air.
El_Water_Rush.Name: Tidal Rush

El_Water_Slam.Desc: Jumps high and slams the ground and launches into the air.
El_Water_Slam.Name: Tidal Slam

El_Water_Volley.Desc: Shoots three balls in a fan and launches into the air.
El_Water_Volley.Name: Tidal Volley

El_Water_Vortex.Desc: A vortex pulls enemies in and hurts them and launches into the air.
El_Water_Vortex.Name: Tidal Vortex

El_Wind_Beam.Desc: Fires a long beam and blows enemies far away.
El_Wind_Beam.Name: Gale Beam

El_Wind_Bolt.Desc: Spits a ball that explodes on the target and blows enemies far away.
El_Wind_Bolt.Name: Gale Bolt

El_Wind_Nova.Desc: Blasts everything around and blows enemies far away.
El_Wind_Nova.Name: Gale Nova

El_Wind_Rain.Desc: Makes it rain from the sky around the target and blows enemies far away.

El_Wind_Slam.Name: Gale Slam

El_Wind_Volley.Desc: Shoots three balls in a fan and blows enemies far away.
El_Wind_Volley.Name: Gale Volley

El_Wind_Vortex.Desc: A vortex pulls enemies in and hurts them and blows enemies far away.
El_Wind_Vortex.Name: Gale Vortex

FireBite.Desc: Flaming bites from all three heads.
FireBite.Name: Fire Bite

FrozenDomain.Desc: Howls, ice spreads, it slides back and unleashes a wave that freezes everything.
FrozenDomain.Name: Frozen Domain

Fus_Earth_Fire_Vortex.Desc: FUSION: stone erupts from the ground, then a Flame vortex, then everything explodes together. It stuns, burns.
Fus_Earth_Fire_Vortex.Name: Magma Burst

Fus_Earth_Ice_Slam.Desc: FUSION: stone erupts from the ground, then a Frost slam, then everything explodes together. It stuns, freezes.
Fus_Earth_Ice_Slam.Name: Glacier Quake

Fus_Earth_Light_Vortex.Desc: FUSION: stone erupts from the ground, then a Holy vortex, then everything explodes together. It stuns, heals you.
Fus_Earth_Light_Vortex.Name: Golden Titan Strike

Fus_Earth_Water_Nature_Vortex.Desc: FUSION: stone erupts from the ground, then a Tidal-Wild vortex, then everything explodes together. It stuns, launches into the air, roots enemies in vines and heals you.
Fus_Earth_Water_Nature_Vortex.Name: World Bloom

Fus_Fire_Earth_Beam.Desc: FUSION: flame erupts from the ground, then a Stone beam, then everything explodes together. It burns, stuns.
Fus_Fire_Earth_Beam.Name: Magma Burst

Fus_Fire_Earth_Vortex.Desc: FUSION: flame erupts from the ground, then a Stone vortex, then everything explodes together. It burns, stuns.
Fus_Fire_Earth_Vortex.Name: Magma Burst

Fus_Fire_Fly_Slam.Desc: FUSION: flame erupts from the ground, then a Sky slam, then everything explodes together. It burns, strikes again from the sky.
Fus_Fire_Fly_Slam.Name: Blazing Wings

Fus_Fire_Fly_Vortex.Desc: FUSION: flame erupts from the ground, then a Sky vortex, then everything explodes together. It burns, strikes again from the sky.
Fus_Fire_Fly_Vortex.Name: Blazing Wings

Fus_Fire_Ice_Thunder_Slam.Desc: FUSION: flame erupts from the ground, then a Frost-Thunder slam, then everything explodes together. It burns, freezes, strikes twice with lightning.
Fus_Fire_Ice_Thunder_Slam.Name: Elemental Trinity

Fus_Fire_Light_Fly_Vortex.Desc: FUSION: flame erupts from the ground, then a Holy-Sky vortex, then everything explodes together. It burns, heals you, strikes again from the sky.
Fus_Fire_Light_Fly_Vortex.Name: Sunfire Nova

Fus_Fire_Wind_Slam.Desc: FUSION: flame erupts from the ground, then a Gale slam, then everything explodes together. It burns, blows enemies far away.
Fus_Fire_Wind_Slam.Name: Firestorm

Fus_Ice_Earth_Vortex.Desc: FUSION: frost erupts from the ground, then a Stone vortex, then everything explodes together. It freezes, stuns.

Fus_Light_Fire_Beam.Desc: FUSION: holy erupts from the ground, then a Flame beam, then everything explodes together. It heals you, burns.

Fus_Light_Fly_Slam.Name: Heaven's Wings

SK_akita_2.Name: Stone Wall

SK_armadillo_dog_2.Desc: Curls into a ball and rolls into the enemy.
SK_armadillo_dog_2.Name: Rolling Ball

SK_armadillo_dog_3.Desc: Bounces around the enemy like a pinball, four hits.
SK_armadillo_dog_3.Name: Pinball

SK_armadillo_dog_4.Desc: SUPREME: becomes a giant boulder and crushes a huge circle around.
SK_armadillo_dog_4.Name: BOULDER AVALANCHE

SK_armored_doberman_2.Desc: Its armor shines and it charges through everyone in a line.
SK_armored_doberman_2.Name: Armor Charge

SK_armored_doberman_3.Desc: Braces in a stone shield (less damage), then breaks it in a quake.
SK_armored_doberman_3.Name: Iron Fortress

SK_astronaut_dog_3.Desc: Gravity turns off: enemies float up... and crash down.
SK_astronaut_dog_3.Name: Zero Gravity

SK_astronaut_dog_4.Desc: SUPREME: blasts off on a rocket and crashes down in a supernova.
SK_astronaut_dog_4.Name: SUPERNOVA LAUNCH

SK_balloon_dog_2.Desc: Tosses three water balloons that pop in splashes.
SK_balloon_dog_2.Name: Water Balloons

SK_balloon_dog_3.Desc: Puffs up and POPS in a confetti explosion that launches enemies.
SK_balloon_dog_3.Name: Party Popper

SK_beagle_2.Desc: Sniffs out the enemy, follows the green scent trail and bites.
SK_beagle_2.Name: Scent Track

SK_beagle_3.Desc: A howl that blows a ring of leaves and roots enemies in vines.
SK_beagle_3.Name: Leafy Howl

SK_bee_dog_2.Desc: Releases a buzzing swarm that chases and poisons the enemy.
SK_bee_dog_2.Name: Bee Swarm

SK_bee_dog_3.Desc: Throws sticky honey: enemies get stuck and the bees dive in.
SK_bee_dog_3.Name: Honey Trap

SK_bone_dragon_2.Desc: Falls apart into bones that rebuild where you aim as a rib cage that traps and crushes.
SK_bone_dragon_2.Name: Bone Cage

SK_bone_dragon_3.Desc: Breathes ghost fire that curses enemies to take more damage.
SK_bone_dragon_3.Name: Ghost Fire Breath

SK_bone_dragon_4.Desc: SUPREME: the ground turns into a graveyard and skeleton dogs rise to attack.
SK_bone_dragon_4.Name: GRAVEYARD RISING

SK_border_collie_2.Desc: Throws a frisbee and leaps to catch it mid-air.
SK_border_collie_2.Name: Frisbee Catch

SK_border_collie_3.Desc: Herds enemies together running around them, then barks them away.
SK_border_collie_3.Name: Herding Rush

SK_boxer_2.Desc: Stands up and boxes: POW! BAM! and a final uppercut.
SK_boxer_2.Name: One-Two Punch

SK_boxer_3.Desc: Runs a turbo lap around the enemy; the wind ring closes and hits twice.
SK_boxer_3.Name: Turbo Lap

SK_brute_bulldog_2.Desc: Flexes so hard it pushes enemies away and hits harder for a while.
SK_brute_bulldog_2.Name: Muscle Flex

SK_brute_bulldog_3.Desc: Jumps sky-high and falls belly-first like a meteor.
SK_brute_bulldog_3.Name: Meteor Belly Slam

SK_brute_bulldog_4.Desc: SUPREME: lifts a giant dumbbell and slams it down three times. The last one stuns.
SK_brute_bulldog_4.Name: GYM TITAN

SK_bulldog_2.Desc: Lowers its head and rams the enemy. BONK!
SK_bulldog_2.Name: Grumpy Headbutt

SK_bulldog_3.Desc: Stomps twice: the ground cracks and the second stomp dizzies.
SK_bulldog_3.Name: Grumpy Stomp

SK_cactus_dog_2.Desc: Shakes and fires a fan of seven needles.
SK_cactus_dog_2.Name: Needle Volley

SK_cactus_dog_3.Desc: Plants itself, blooms and fires needles all around, rooting enemies.
SK_cactus_dog_3.Name: Cactus Bloom

SK_caramelo_2.Desc: Tosses a stick at the enemy and runs to catch it in the air.
SK_caramelo_2.Name: Stick Fetch

SK_caramelo_3.Desc: Turns around, digs and kicks a wave of dirt that slows enemies.
SK_caramelo_3.Name: Dirt Kick

SK_celestial_dog_2.Desc: A shower of falling stars on the enemy.
SK_celestial_dog_2.Name: Star Shower

SK_celestial_dog_3.Desc: Its wings glow and rain holy feathers; heals.
SK_celestial_dog_3.Name: Heaven's Wings

SK_celestial_dog_4.Desc: SUPREME: draws a constellation in the sky that comes alive and pounces.
SK_celestial_dog_4.Name: CONSTELLATION

SK_chihuahua_2.Desc: Three angry yaps in a cone. The third one dizzies.
SK_chihuahua_2.Name: Yap Yap Yap

SK_chihuahua_3.Desc: Jumps up and down in a tantrum making angry sound waves.
SK_chihuahua_3.Name: Tiny Tantrum

SK_chrono_hound_2.Desc: A giant clock stops time where you aim. Its echoes slash from every side and it all explodes when time resumes.
SK_chrono_hound_2.Name: Time Stop

SK_chrono_hound_3.Desc: Strikes, rewinds time and strikes again from the same spot, three times.
SK_chrono_hound_3.Name: Rewind Strike

SK_chrono_hound_4.Desc: SUPREME: a giant clock strikes six; each strike is a bolt of holy lightning.
SK_chrono_hound_4.Name: JUDGMENT HOUR

SK_clown_dog_2.Desc: Throws 3 cream pies toward where you aim. SPLAT! Enemies hit are slowed. Your clones throw too!
SK_clown_dog_2.Name: Pie Prank

SK_clown_dog_3.Desc: A jack-in-the-box pops up where you aim: BOING! The spring clown launches enemies up and makes them dizzy.
SK_clown_dog_3.Name: Jack-in-the-Box

SK_clown_dog_4.Desc: SUPREME: a haunted circus tent drops where you aim, pumpkins rain, clown heads fly out and it ends in a confetti blast.
SK_clown_dog_4.Name: Circus of Doom

SK_corgi_2.Desc: Flips onto the enemy and bounces on its fluffy butt. BOING!
SK_corgi_2.Name: Butt Bounce

SK_corgi_3.Desc: Tucks into a bread loaf and rolls right through enemies.
SK_corgi_3.Name: Loaf Roll

SK_cosmic_dog_2.Desc: Floats glowing and a shower of comets crashes where you aim.
SK_cosmic_dog_2.Name: Starfall

SK_cosmic_dog_3.Desc: Five stars surround the enemy, link up with light and explode.
SK_cosmic_dog_3.Name: Constellation Trap

SK_cosmic_dog_4.Desc: SUPREME: rises into the sky, everything goes dark... and explodes into a galaxy.
SK_cosmic_dog_4.Name: BIG BANG

SK_crystal_golem_2.Desc: Crystal spikes race to where you aim and trap enemies in a giant crystal, then a huge crystal shatters it.
SK_crystal_golem_2.Name: Crystal Prison

SK_crystal_golem_3.Desc: Punches the ground and a wave of crystal spikes races to the enemy.
SK_crystal_golem_3.Name: Shard Quake

SK_crystal_golem_4.Desc: SUPREME: giant crystals rise around it as a shield, then explode outward.
SK_crystal_golem_4.Name: DIAMOND FORTRESS

SK_crystal_hound_2.Desc: A line of crystals erupts from the ground toward the enemy.
SK_crystal_hound_2.Name: Crystal Path

SK_crystal_hound_3.Desc: Its gem charges and fires a beam that splits in three; heals a little.
SK_crystal_hound_3.Name: Prism Beam

SK_dalmatian_2.Desc: Sprays a strong water jet that pushes enemies back.
SK_dalmatian_2.Name: Fire Hose

SK_dalmatian_3.Desc: Shakes off its black spots: they fly out and splash like water balloons.
SK_dalmatian_3.Name: Spot Splash

SK_demon_samurai_2.Desc: The four katanas fly out, spin around where you aim slicing, then return for a final X slash.
SK_demon_samurai_2.Name: Oni Blades

SK_demon_samurai_3.Desc: Three slashing dashes leave burning cuts that explode.
SK_demon_samurai_3.Name: Demon Dash

SK_demon_samurai_4.Desc: SUPREME: an Oni mask in the sky, a fire tornado and spinning blades.
SK_demon_samurai_4.Name: BLAZING TEMPEST

SK_dj_dog_2.Desc: Speakers drop in and pump three bass waves.
SK_dj_dog_2.Name: Bass Drop

SK_dj_dog_3.Desc: A disco ball and dance floor: enemies can't stop dancing!
SK_dj_dog_3.Name: Disco Fever

SK_dj_dog_4.Desc: SUPREME: a stage of speakers, lightning on every beat and a huge drop.
SK_dj_dog_4.Name: THUNDER RAVE

SK_dragon_hound_2.Desc: Takes a deep breath and sweeps a flamethrower.
SK_dragon_hound_2.Name: Dragon Breath

SK_dragon_hound_3.Desc: Flies up and dives through the enemy, leaving a trail of fire.
SK_dragon_hound_3.Name: Blazing Wings

SK_dragon_hound_4.Desc: SUPREME: soars high, rains giant fireballs and breathes fire from the sky.
SK_dragon_hound_4.Name: DRAGON'S FURY

SK_flytrap_dog_2.Desc: A flytrap pops out under the enemy and snaps it shut.
SK_flytrap_dog_2.Name: Snap Trap

SK_flytrap_dog_3.Desc: Vines burst out and whip everything around four times.
SK_flytrap_dog_3.Name: Vine Whip

SK_flytrap_dog_4.Desc: SUPREME: a giant flytrap swallows the enemy and the jungle grows around.
SK_flytrap_dog_4.Name: JUNGLE DEVOUR

SK_frost_beast_2.Desc: Icicles grow on its back and launch at the enemy.
SK_frost_beast_2.Name: Icicle Barrage

SK_frost_beast_3.Desc: Slams the ground: everything around freezes solid.
SK_frost_beast_3.Name: Frozen Domain

SK_frost_beast_4.Desc: SUPREME: an eternal winter falls; giant icicles rain and everything freezes.
SK_frost_beast_4.Name: ETERNAL WINTER

SK_frost_phoenix_2.Desc: Becomes an ice egg and heals; it cracks into a freezing storm and a volley of ice feathers flies where you aim.
SK_frost_phoenix_2.Name: Glacial Rebirth

SK_frost_phoenix_3.Desc: Flaps its wings into a freezing blizzard.
SK_frost_phoenix_3.Name: Blizzard Wings

SK_frost_phoenix_4.Desc: SUPREME: a giant ice phoenix crosses the frozen sky and icicles rain down.
SK_frost_phoenix_4.Name: FROZEN SKY

SK_galgo_2.Desc: Sprints through the enemy and back, leaving a wind tunnel.
SK_galgo_2.Name: Slipstream

SK_galgo_3.Desc: 3, 2, 1, GO! A rocket start that sends enemies flying.
SK_galgo_3.Name: Starting Gate

SK_ghost_hound_2.Desc: Fades away and reappears behind the enemy with a critical bite.
SK_ghost_hound_2.Name: Phase Bite

SK_ghost_hound_3.Desc: Wails and little ghosts fly out to haunt and slow the enemies.
SK_ghost_hound_3.Name: Haunting Wail

SK_ghost_hound_4.Desc: SUPREME: night falls, ghosts rise from the ground and dive at enemies. BOO!
SK_ghost_hound_4.Name: POLTERGEIST NIGHT

SK_golden_2.Desc: Throws a tennis ball that bounces back; catching it heals a little.
SK_golden_2.Name: Tennis Fetch

SK_golden_3.Desc: Sits happily and pulses warm light: damages around and heals.
SK_golden_3.Name: Sunny Heart

SK_horned_pup_2.Desc: Charges, tosses the enemy up with its horns and rams it again.
SK_horned_pup_2.Name: Horn Toss

SK_horned_pup_3.Desc: Stomps and a stampede of spirit bulls charges through the enemy.
SK_horned_pup_3.Name: Spirit Stampede

SK_hydra_hound_2.Desc: The five heads stretch like snakes and bite from five sides. Every bite that lands heals.
SK_hydra_hound_2.Name: Hydra Frenzy

SK_hydra_hound_3.Desc: A wave of poisoned water crashes over the enemies.
SK_hydra_hound_3.Name: Venom Tide

SK_hydra_hound_4.Desc: SUPREME: five giant serpent heads rise from the ground and strike. Heals.
SK_hydra_hound_4.Name: HYDRA RISING

SK_inferno_hound_2.Desc: A ring of fire bursts out around it and burns.
SK_inferno_hound_2.Name: Inferno Ring

SK_inferno_hound_3.Desc: Five pillars of fire erupt toward the enemy.
SK_inferno_hound_3.Name: Hellfire Pillars

SK_inferno_hound_4.Desc: SUPREME: the ground turns to lava and a fire tornado rages.
SK_inferno_hound_4.Name: INFERNO APOCALYPSE

SK_knight_dog_2.Desc: Raises its shield and bashes the enemy, stunning it.
SK_knight_dog_2.Name: Shield Bash

SK_knight_dog_3.Desc: Charges with a glowing lance and plants a pillar of light.
SK_knight_dog_3.Name: Holy Lance

SK_knight_dog_4.Desc: SUPREME: a giant golden sword falls from the sky. Heals the knight.
SK_knight_dog_4.Name: EXCALIBUR

SK_kraken_hound_2.Desc: Giant tentacles burst where you aim, lift enemies up and smash them down. Ends in a blast of ink.
SK_kraken_hound_2.Name: Kraken Grab

SK_kraken_hound_3.Desc: A whirlpool pulls enemies in while tentacles slap them.
SK_kraken_hound_3.Name: Whirlpool

SK_kraken_hound_4.Desc: SUPREME: eight giant tentacles rise and slam, then a tidal wave.
SK_kraken_hound_4.Name: RELEASE THE KRAKEN

SK_magma_hound_2.Desc: Spits three lava globs that leave burning pools.
SK_magma_hound_2.Name: Lava Pools

SK_magma_hound_3.Desc: Cracks the ground and lava geysers erupt in a line.
SK_magma_hound_3.Name: Magma Burst

SK_magma_hound_4.Desc: SUPREME: a volcano rises under the enemy and erupts lava bombs.
SK_magma_hound_4.Name: VOLCANO HEART

SK_mecha_hound_2.Desc: Locks onto where you aim and fires a barrage of missiles, then a plasma cannon blast.
SK_mecha_hound_2.Name: Missile Barrage

SK_mecha_hound_3.Desc: Charges its chest cannon and fires a massive photon beam.
SK_mecha_hound_3.Name: Photon Cannon

SK_mecha_hound_4.Desc: SUPREME: targets locked — orbital lasers strike from space.
SK_mecha_hound_4.Name: OMEGA PROTOCOL

SK_mummy_dog_2.Desc: Shoots bandages that wrap the enemy up and pull it close.
SK_mummy_dog_2.Name: Mummy Wrap

SK_mummy_dog_3.Desc: A cursed sandstorm with scarabs: enemies take more damage.
SK_mummy_dog_3.Name: Sandstorm Curse

SK_mummy_dog_4.Desc: SUPREME: a golden sarcophagus traps the enemy and explodes in light.
SK_mummy_dog_4.Name: PHARAOH'S TOMB

SK_mushroom_dog_2.Desc: A puff of sleepy spores puts the enemy to sleep.
SK_mushroom_dog_2.Name: Sleepy Spores

SK_mushroom_dog_3.Desc: A ring of mushrooms sprouts around the enemy and puffs poison.
SK_mushroom_dog_3.Name: Fairy Ring

SK_ninja_dog_2.Desc: Throws five spinning shurikens in a fan.
SK_ninja_dog_2.Name: Shuriken Fan

SK_ninja_dog_3.Desc: Three shadow clones attack from three sides and vanish in smoke.
SK_ninja_dog_3.Name: Shadow Clones

SK_ninja_dog_4.Desc: SUPREME: vanishes and strikes from every direction, then a final X cut.
SK_ninja_dog_4.Name: THOUSAND SHADOWS

SK_octopus_dog_2.Desc: Sprays a cloud of ink that slows and hurts.
SK_octopus_dog_2.Name: Ink Cloud

SK_octopus_dog_3.Desc: Four tentacles burst from the ground and slam down.
SK_octopus_dog_3.Name: Tentacle Slam

SK_octopus_dog_4.Desc: SUPREME: a dark whirlpool pulls enemies into tentacles from the deep.
SK_octopus_dog_4.Name: ABYSSAL WHIRLPOOL

SK_pastor_alemao_2.Desc: Locks on, leaps and pins the enemy down with bites.
SK_pastor_alemao_2.Name: K9 Takedown

SK_pastor_alemao_3.Desc: Police siren on! Red and blue bark waves end in a shocking zap.
SK_pastor_alemao_3.Name: Siren Bark

SK_phoenix_hound_2.Desc: Wings ablaze, dives toward where you aim and explodes, leaving burning ground.
SK_phoenix_hound_2.Name: Phoenix Dive

SK_phoenix_hound_3.Desc: Circles high above the enemy and dives like a meteor, leaving the ground ablaze.
SK_phoenix_hound_3.Name: Firestorm Dive

SK_phoenix_hound_4.Desc: SUPREME: a giant fire phoenix sweeps the sky and burning feathers rain down.
SK_phoenix_hound_4.Name: PHOENIX SKYFALL

SK_pinscher_2.Desc: Trembles, zips in for two quick nips and zips back.
SK_pinscher_2.Name: Nervous Nip

SK_pinscher_3.Desc: Spins so fast it makes a little tornado that runs into the enemy.
SK_pinscher_3.Name: Tiny Twister

SK_pirate_dog_2.Desc: Throws its anchor, hooks the enemy and pulls it in.
SK_pirate_dog_2.Name: Anchor Hook

SK_pirate_dog_3.Desc: Cannonballs fly in from the sea around the enemy.
SK_pirate_dog_3.Name: Cannon Barrage

SK_pirate_dog_4.Desc: SUPREME: a ghost ship sails through, fires a broadside and a giant wave.
SK_pirate_dog_4.Name: GHOST SHIP

SK_planet_hound_2.Desc: The moon leaves orbit and crashes where you aim; its rings become a shockwave.
SK_planet_hound_2.Name: Moonfall

SK_planet_hound_3.Desc: Flowers bloom, water geysers burst and vines hold the enemies.
SK_planet_hound_3.Name: World Bloom

SK_planet_hound_4.Desc: SUPREME: a whole planet falls from the sky, oceans and jungles follow.
SK_planet_hound_4.Name: LIVING PLANET

SK_poodle_2.Desc: A fancy pirouette that throws pom-poms all around.
SK_poodle_2.Name: Pom-Pom Pirouette

SK_poodle_3.Desc: Blows a pink perfume breeze that charms enemies for a moment.
SK_poodle_3.Name: Perfume Breeze

SK_pug_2.Desc: Hops up and lands belly-first on the enemy. BONK!
SK_pug_2.Name: Belly Flop

SK_pug_3.Desc: Lies down and snores so loud the ground shakes. The last snore puts enemies to sleep.
SK_pug_3.Name: Snore Quake

SK_rainbow_unicorn_2.Desc: A rainbow forms toward where you aim; it gallops across and lands horn-first in a burst of color.
SK_rainbow_unicorn_2.Name: Rainbow Bridge

SK_rainbow_unicorn_3.Desc: Fires three rainbow beams in a fan.
SK_rainbow_unicorn_3.Name: Prism Burst

SK_rainbow_unicorn_4.Desc: SUPREME: a rainbow sky and a downpour of colorful stars. Heals.
SK_rainbow_unicorn_4.Name: RAINBOW DELUGE

SK_robo_dog_2.Desc: Fires a red laser from its eyes and sweeps it across.
SK_robo_dog_2.Name: Laser Sweep

SK_robo_dog_3.Desc: Its back opens and six mini missiles rain on the enemy.
SK_robo_dog_3.Name: Mini Missiles

SK_saber_dog_2.Desc: Pounces and slashes with its saber fangs, making the enemy bleed.
SK_saber_dog_2.Name: Saber Maul

SK_saber_dog_3.Desc: A freezing roar that turns enemies into ice.
SK_saber_dog_3.Name: Ice Age Roar

SK_saber_dog_4.Desc: SUPREME: glaciers rise and a giant sabertooth spirit leaps through.
SK_saber_dog_4.Name: EXTINCTION

SK_salsicha_2.Desc: Throws a hot dog that bounces twice on the enemy.
SK_salsicha_2.Name: Hot Dog Toss

SK_salsicha_3.Desc: Digs a tunnel under the enemy and pops out launching it up.
SK_salsicha_3.Name: Tunnel Pop

SK_samurai_shiba_2.Desc: A lightning-fast draw: dashes through the enemy and the cut lands a moment later.
SK_samurai_shiba_2.Name: Iaijutsu

SK_samurai_shiba_3.Desc: Spins its katana in a storm of cherry petals.
SK_samurai_shiba_3.Name: Sakura Storm

SK_samurai_shiba_4.Desc: SUPREME: the sky darkens, dozens of cuts appear around the enemy and all strike at once.
SK_samurai_shiba_4.Name: THOUSAND CUTS

SK_sao_bernardo_2.Desc: Throws its rescue barrel; it bursts in snow and the hot cocoa heals it.
SK_sao_bernardo_2.Name: Rescue Barrel

SK_sao_bernardo_3.Desc: Slams the ground and a giant snowball rolls over enemies.
SK_sao_bernardo_3.Name: Avalanche Ball

SK_scorpion_dog_2.Desc: Strikes with its tail stinger and poisons.
SK_scorpion_dog_2.Name: Stinger

SK_scorpion_dog_3.Desc: A sand pit opens under the enemy, pulling it in and poisoning.
SK_scorpion_dog_3.Name: Toxic Sands

SK_scorpion_dog_4.Desc: SUPREME: a giant scorpion tail rises from the sand and stabs three times.
SK_scorpion_dog_4.Name: DESERT KING

SK_seraph_hound_2.Desc: Spreads its six wings: pillars of light surround where you aim and close into a holy column. Heals a little.
SK_seraph_hound_2.Name: Divine Judgement

SK_seraph_hound_3.Desc: Its six wings unleash a storm of razor-sharp golden feathers.
SK_seraph_hound_3.Name: Feather Storm

SK_seraph_hound_4.Desc: SUPREME: the gates of heaven open and holy spears rain down. Heals.
SK_seraph_hound_4.Name: HEAVEN'S GATE

SK_shadow_cerberus_2.Desc: A hell portal opens where you aim: three spectral heads bite and shadow spikes launch enemies.
SK_shadow_cerberus_2.Name: Hell Gate

SK_shadow_cerberus_3.Desc: The three heads breathe shadow fire in three directions, spinning.
SK_shadow_cerberus_3.Name: Triple Inferno

SK_shadow_cerberus_4.Desc: SUPREME: the sky burns red and three hellhounds hunt the enemies down.
SK_shadow_cerberus_4.Name: HELLHOUND PACK

SK_shadow_doberman_2.Desc: Melts into a shadow, slides under the enemy and bursts out biting.
SK_shadow_doberman_2.Name: Shadow Step

SK_shadow_doberman_3.Desc: Four nightmare clones rush in from all sides and explode.
SK_shadow_doberman_3.Name: Nightmare Clones

SK_shadow_doberman_4.Desc: SUPREME: total darkness and bites from everywhere, then a critical strike.
SK_shadow_doberman_4.Name: ETERNAL NIGHT

SK_shark_dog_2.Desc: Dives into the ground like water and bursts out biting.
SK_shark_dog_2.Name: Fin Dive

SK_shark_dog_3.Desc: Circles the enemy with its fin, then bites from three sides.
SK_shark_dog_3.Name: Feeding Frenzy

SK_shark_dog_4.Desc: SUPREME: a giant shark bursts from the ground and chomps everything.
SK_shark_dog_4.Name: MEGALODON

SK_singularity_pup_2.Desc: A black hole forms where you aim, grinds enemies in orbit and spits them far away through a white hole.
SK_singularity_pup_2.Name: Event Horizon

SK_singularity_pup_3.Desc: Lifts the enemies into the air and crushes them into the ground.
SK_singularity_pup_3.Name: Gravity Crush

SK_singularity_pup_4.Desc: SUPREME: a supermassive black hole pulls everything in and bursts in white light.
SK_singularity_pup_4.Name: SUPERMASSIVE

SK_skull_dog_2.Desc: Throws a spinning bone that hits on the way out and on the way back.
SK_skull_dog_2.Name: Boomerang Bone

SK_skull_dog_3.Desc: Rattles its ribs: bones burst from the ground and curse the enemy.
SK_skull_dog_3.Name: Bone Rattle

SK_snow_husky_2.Desc: Slides on its belly leaving an ice trail. Enemies hit are slowed.
SK_snow_husky_2.Name: Sled Dash

SK_snow_husky_3.Desc: Howls up a small blizzard on the enemy that ends in a freeze.
SK_snow_husky_3.Name: Snowstorm Howl

SK_stone_hound_2.Desc: Rips a boulder from the ground and throws it.
SK_stone_hound_2.Name: Boulder Toss

SK_stone_hound_3.Desc: Covers itself in rocks and rolls through enemies twice, then bursts them.
SK_stone_hound_3.Name: Rock Armor Roll

SK_storm_pup_2.Desc: Zigzags around the enemy leaving lightning, then strikes and shocks.
SK_storm_pup_2.Name: Thunder Hunt

SK_storm_pup_3.Desc: A storm cloud over the enemy drops four lightning bolts.
SK_storm_pup_3.Name: Static Storm

SK_storm_wolf_2.Desc: An electric bite that chains lightning to nearby enemies.
SK_storm_wolf_2.Name: Thunder Fang

SK_storm_wolf_3.Desc: Howls up a cyclone with lightning around the enemy.
SK_storm_wolf_3.Name: Howling Tempest

SK_storm_wolf_4.Desc: SUPREME: a storm brings four lightning wolves that hunt the enemies.
SK_storm_wolf_4.Name: WOLF PACK STORM

SK_sun_dragon_2.Desc: A sweeping beam of golden sunfire toward where you aim, then a small sun crashes there. Heals.
SK_sun_dragon_2.Name: Sunfire Breath

SK_sun_dragon_3.Desc: Wings ablaze, dives through the enemy and bursts in a solar flare. Heals.
SK_sun_dragon_3.Name: Solar Wings

SK_sun_dragon_4.Desc: SUPREME: a sun descends from the sky, sweeps with solar rays and goes supernova.
SK_sun_dragon_4.Name: DIVINE SUNFIRE

SK_tank_dog_2.Desc: Fires a heavy cannon shell that explodes.
SK_tank_dog_2.Name: Tank Shell

SK_tank_dog_3.Desc: Six artillery shells rain on marked spots.
SK_tank_dog_3.Name: Heavy Artillery

SK_tank_dog_4.Desc: SUPREME: bomber planes fly over and drop a line of bombs.
SK_tank_dog_4.Name: CARPET BOMB

SK_thunder_colossus_2.Desc: Three stomps: each sends a wall of lightning marching to where you aim. The last one shocks.

akita.Name: Stone Wall

akita.Name: Loyal Leap
akita.Pt: Pula bem alto e cai com um anel de pedras saindo do chão.

alien_dog.Name: Tractor Beam

alien_dog.Desc: Glowing crop circles appear and blast up one after another.
alien_dog.Name: Crop Circles
alien_dog.Pt: Círculos misteriosos brilham no chão e explodem para cima um atrás do outro.

alien_dog.Desc: SUPREME: the mothership arrives and fires a giant laser down.
alien_dog.Name: MOTHERSHIP
alien_dog.Pt: SUPREMO: a nave-mãe chega no céu e solta um laser gigante.

armadillo_dog.Name: Rolling Ball
armadillo_dog.Pt: Vira uma bola e rola no inimigo.

armadillo_dog.Name: Pinball
armadillo_dog.Pt: Quica em volta do inimigo como fliperama (4 batidas).

armadillo_dog.Desc: SUPREME: becomes a giant boulder and crushes a huge circle around.
armadillo_dog.Name: BOULDER AVALANCHE
armadillo_dog.Pt: SUPREMO: vira uma pedra gigante e esmaga tudo dando uma volta enorme.

armored_doberman.Desc: Its armor shines and it charges through everyone in a line.
armored_doberman.Name: Armor Charge
armored_doberman.Pt: A armadura brilha e ele atropela todos numa linha reta.

armored_doberman.Desc: Braces in a stone shield (less damage), then breaks it in a quake.
armored_doberman.Name: Iron Fortress
armored_doberman.Pt: Fica firme com escudo de pedra (leva menos dano) e depois solta um terremoto em volta.

astronaut_dog.Desc: Gravity turns off: enemies float up... and crash down.
astronaut_dog.Name: Zero Gravity
astronaut_dog.Pt: A gravidade desliga: os inimigos flutuam... e caem com tudo.

astronaut_dog.Desc: SUPREME: blasts off on a rocket and crashes down in a supernova.
astronaut_dog.Name: SUPERNOVA LAUNCH
astronaut_dog.Pt: SUPREMO: decola num foguete e cai como uma supernova.

balloon_dog.Desc: Tosses three water balloons that pop in splashes.
balloon_dog.Name: Water Balloons
balloon_dog.Pt: Joga 3 bexigas d'água em arco que estouram.

balloon_dog.Desc: Puffs up and POPS in a confetti explosion that launches enemies.
balloon_dog.Name: Party Popper
balloon_dog.Pt: Enche, enche... e ESTOURA numa explosão de confete que joga para cima.

beagle.Desc: Sniffs out the enemy, follows the green scent trail and bites.
beagle.Name: Scent Track
beagle.Pt: Fareja, aparece um rastro de cheiro verde até o inimigo, corre por ele e morde.

beagle.Desc: A howl that blows a ring of leaves and roots enemies in vines.
beagle.Name: Leafy Howl
beagle.Pt: Uiva e solta um anel de folhas que prende os inimigos em vinhas.

bee_dog.Desc: Releases a buzzing swarm that chases and poisons the enemy.
bee_dog.Name: Bee Swarm
bee_dog.Pt: Solta um enxame de abelhas que persegue e envenena.

bee_dog.Desc: Throws sticky honey: enemies get stuck and the bees dive in.
bee_dog.Name: Honey Trap
bee_dog.Pt: Joga mel grudento: o inimigo fica preso e as abelhas mergulham picando.

bone_dragon.Desc: Falls apart into bones that rebuild where you aim as a rib cage that traps and crushes.
bone_dragon.Name: Bone Cage
bone_dragon.Pt: Desmonta em ossos que remontam na setinha como uma gaiola de costelas que prende e esmaga.

bone_dragon.Desc: Breathes ghost fire that curses enemies to take more damage.
bone_dragon.Name: Ghost Fire Breath
bone_dragon.Pt: Sopra fogo fantasma que amaldiçoa (o inimigo leva mais dano).

bone_dragon.Desc: SUPREME: the ground turns into a graveyard and skeleton dogs rise to attack.
bone_dragon.Name: GRAVEYARD RISING
bone_dragon.Pt: SUPREMO: o chão vira cemitério e cães esqueletos saem da terra para atacar.

border_collie.Desc: Throws a frisbee and leaps to catch it mid-air.
border_collie.Name: Frisbee Catch
border_collie.Pt: Joga o frisbee e salta para pegar no ar (os dois acertam).

border_collie.Desc: Herds enemies together running around them, then barks them away.
border_collie.Name: Herding Rush
border_collie.Pt: Corre em volta pastoreando, junta os inimigos no meio e late empurrando.

boxer.Desc: Stands up and boxes: POW! BAM! and a final uppercut.
boxer.Name: One-Two Punch
boxer.Pt: Fica em pé e dá socos: POW! BAM! e um gancho final que joga para cima.

boxer.Desc: Runs a turbo lap around the enemy; the wind ring closes and hits twice.
boxer.Name: Turbo Lap
boxer.Pt: Dá uma volta turbo em volta do inimigo; o anel de vento fecha e acerta 2 vezes.

brute_bulldog.Desc: Flexes so hard it pushes enemies away and hits harder for a while.
brute_bulldog.Name: Muscle Flex
brute_bulldog.Pt: Faz pose de músculo: empurra os inimigos e bate mais forte por um tempo.

brute_bulldog.Desc: Jumps sky-high and falls belly-first like a meteor.
brute_bulldog.Name: Meteor Belly Slam
brute_bulldog.Pt: Pula até o céu e cai de barriga como um meteoro (cratera e pedras).

brute_bulldog.Name: GYM TITAN
brute_bulldog.Pt: SUPREMO: levanta um haltere gigante e bate no chão 3 vezes, cada vez maior; a última atordoa.

bulldog.Desc: Lowers its head and rams the enemy. BONK!

bulldog.Pt: Abaixa a cabeça, carrega e dá uma cabeçada (BONK!).

bulldog.Desc: Stomps twice: the ground cracks and the second stomp dizzies.
bulldog.Name: Grumpy Stomp
bulldog.Pt: Pisa forte 2 vezes; o chão racha e a 2ª pisada deixa tonto.

cactus_dog.Desc: Shakes and fires a fan of seven needles.
cactus_dog.Name: Needle Volley
cactus_dog.Pt: Sacode e atira um leque de 7 espinhos.

cactus_dog.Desc: Plants itself, blooms and fires needles all around, rooting enemies.
cactus_dog.Name: Cactus Bloom
cactus_dog.Pt: Se planta no chão, floresce e atira espinhos para todos os lados; prende em vinhas.

caramelo.Desc: Tosses a stick at the enemy and runs to catch it in the air.
caramelo.Name: Stick Fetch
caramelo.Pt: Joga um graveto com a boca e corre para pegar no ar (o graveto e o salto acertam).

caramelo.Desc: Turns around, digs and kicks a wave of dirt that slows enemies.
caramelo.Name: Dirt Kick
caramelo.Pt: Vira de costas, cava e chuta uma onda de terra e pedrinhas para trás; deixa lento.

celestial_dog.Desc: A shower of falling stars on the enemy.
celestial_dog.Name: Star Shower
celestial_dog.Pt: Uma chuva de estrelas cadentes no inimigo.

celestial_dog.Desc: Its wings glow and rain holy feathers; heals.
celestial_dog.Name: Heaven's Wings
celestial_dog.Pt: As asas brilham e fazem chover penas sagradas; cura.

celestial_dog.Desc: SUPREME: draws a constellation in the sky that comes alive and pounces.
celestial_dog.Name: CONSTELLATION
celestial_dog.Pt: SUPREMO: desenha uma constelação no céu que ganha vida e pula no inimigo.

chihuahua.Desc: Three angry yaps in a cone. The third one dizzies.
chihuahua.Name: Yap Yap Yap
chihuahua.Pt: Treme de raiva e dá 3 latidos em cone (YAP!); o 3º deixa tonto.

chihuahua.Desc: Jumps up and down in a tantrum making angry sound waves.
chihuahua.Name: Tiny Tantrum
chihuahua.Pt: Faz birra pulando sem parar; cada pulo solta uma onda de som e a última empurra longe.

chrono_hound.Desc: A giant clock stops time where you aim. Its echoes slash from every side and it all explodes when time resumes.
chrono_hound.Name: Time Stop
chrono_hound.Pt: Um relógio gigante para o tempo na setinha; imagens dele cortam de 5 lados e tudo explode quando o tempo volta.

chrono_hound.Desc: Strikes, rewinds time and strikes again from the same spot, three times.
chrono_hound.Name: Rewind Strike
chrono_hound.Pt: Ataca, volta no tempo e ataca de novo do mesmo lugar, 3 vezes; deixa lento.

chrono_hound.Desc: SUPREME: a giant clock strikes six; each strike is a bolt of holy lightning.
chrono_hound.Name: JUDGMENT HOUR
chrono_hound.Pt: SUPREMO: um relógio gigante bate 6 horas; cada badalada é um raio sagrado.

clown_dog.Desc: Throws 3 cream pies toward where you aim. SPLAT! Enemies hit are slowed. Your clones throw too!
clown_dog.Name: Pie Prank
clown_dog.Pt: Joga 3 tortas de creme na direção da setinha (SPLAT!); quem leva fica lento. Os clones jogam junto.

clown_dog.Desc: A jack-in-the-box pops up where you aim: BOING! The spring clown launches enemies up and makes them dizzy.
clown_dog.Name: Jack-in-the-Box
clown_dog.Pt: Uma caixa-surpresa sobe na setinha: BOING! O palhaço de mola joga todo mundo para cima e deixa tonto.

clown_dog.Desc: SUPREME: a haunted circus tent drops where you aim, pumpkins rain, clown heads fly out and it ends in a confetti blast.
clown_dog.Name: Circus of Doom
clown_dog.Pt: SUPREMO: uma tenda de circo assombrada cai na setinha, chovem abóboras, cabeças de palhaço voam e tudo explode em confete.

corgi.Desc: Flips onto the enemy and bounces on its fluffy butt. BOING!
corgi.Name: Butt Bounce
corgi.Pt: Dá um mortal, cai sentado em cima do inimigo e quica de novo (BOING!).

corgi.Desc: Tucks into a bread loaf and rolls right through enemies.
corgi.Name: Loaf Roll
corgi.Pt: Vira um pãozinho e sai rolando por cima dos inimigos (solta farelos).

cosmic_dog.Desc: Floats glowing and a shower of comets crashes where you aim.
cosmic_dog.Name: Starfall
cosmic_dog.Pt: Flutua brilhando e uma chuva de cometas cai na setinha (3 no centro).

cosmic_dog.Desc: Five stars surround the enemy, link up with light and explode.
cosmic_dog.Name: Constellation Trap
cosmic_dog.Pt: 5 estrelas cercam o inimigo, se ligam com linhas de luz e explodem.

cosmic_dog.Desc: SUPREME: rises into the sky, everything goes dark... and explodes into a galaxy.
cosmic_dog.Name: BIG BANG
cosmic_dog.Pt: SUPREMO: sobe ao céu, tudo escurece... e explode numa galáxia.

crystal_golem.Desc: Crystal spikes race to where you aim and trap enemies in a giant crystal, then a huge crystal shatters it.
crystal_golem.Name: Crystal Prison
crystal_golem.Pt: Espinhos de cristal correm até a setinha e prendem num cristal gigante; um cristal enorme cai e estilhaça a prisão.

crystal_golem.Desc: Punches the ground and a wave of crystal spikes races to the enemy.
crystal_golem.Name: Shard Quake
crystal_golem.Pt: Soca o chão e uma onda de espinhos de cristal corre até o inimigo.

crystal_golem.Desc: SUPREME: giant crystals rise around it as a shield, then explode outward.
crystal_golem.Name: DIAMOND FORTRESS
crystal_golem.Pt: SUPREMO: cristais gigantes sobem em volta como escudo e depois explodem para fora.

crystal_hound.Desc: A line of crystals erupts from the ground toward the enemy.
crystal_hound.Name: Crystal Path
crystal_hound.Pt: Uma fila de cristais brota do chão até o inimigo.

crystal_hound.Desc: Its gem charges and fires a beam that splits in three; heals a little.
crystal_hound.Name: Prism Beam
crystal_hound.Pt: A pedra preciosa carrega e solta um raio que se divide em 3; cura um pouco.

dalmatian.Desc: Sprays a strong water jet that pushes enemies back.
dalmatian.Name: Fire Hose
dalmatian.Pt: Mangueira de bombeiro: jato de água forte que empurra.

dalmatian.Desc: Shakes off its black spots: they fly out and splash like water balloons.
dalmatian.Name: Spot Splash
dalmatian.Pt: Sacode como cachorro molhado e as pintas pretas voam e estouram como bexigas d'água.

demon_samurai.Desc: The four katanas fly out, spin around where you aim slicing, then return for a final X slash.
demon_samurai.Name: Oni Blades
demon_samurai.Pt: As 4 katanas voam, giram cortando na setinha e voltam num corte final em X.

demon_samurai.Desc: Three slashing dashes leave burning cuts that explode.
demon_samurai.Name: Demon Dash
demon_samurai.Pt: 3 arrancadas cortando deixam cortes de fogo que explodem.

demon_samurai.Desc: SUPREME: an Oni mask in the sky, a fire tornado and spinning blades.
demon_samurai.Name: BLAZING TEMPEST
demon_samurai.Pt: SUPREMO: uma máscara de Oni no céu, um tornado de fogo e espadas girando no inimigo.

dj_dog.Desc: Speakers drop in and pump three bass waves.
dj_dog.Name: Bass Drop
dj_dog.Pt: Caixas de som aparecem e soltam 3 ondas de grave que empurram.

dj_dog.Desc: A disco ball and dance floor: enemies can't stop dancing!
dj_dog.Name: Disco Fever
dj_dog.Pt: Globo de discoteca e pista de dança: os inimigos não param de dançar!

dj_dog.Desc: SUPREME: a stage of speakers, lightning on every beat and a huge drop.
dj_dog.Name: THUNDER RAVE
dj_dog.Pt: SUPREMO: palco de caixas de som, raios em cada batida e uma explosão de confete no fim.

dragon_hound.Desc: Takes a deep breath and sweeps a flamethrower.
dragon_hound.Name: Dragon Breath
dragon_hound.Pt: Puxa o ar e solta um lança-chamas varrendo.

dragon_hound.Desc: Flies up and dives through the enemy, leaving a trail of fire.
dragon_hound.Name: Blazing Wings
dragon_hound.Pt: Voa e mergulha atravessando o inimigo, deixando um rastro de fogo.

dragon_hound.Desc: SUPREME: soars high, rains giant fireballs and breathes fire from the sky.
dragon_hound.Name: DRAGON'S FURY
dragon_hound.Pt: SUPREMO: sobe ao céu, faz chover bolas de fogo gigantes e sopra fogo lá de cima.

flytrap_dog.Desc: A flytrap pops out under the enemy and snaps it shut.
flytrap_dog.Name: Snap Trap
flytrap_dog.Pt: Uma planta carnívora brota embaixo do inimigo e fecha nele (fica preso).

flytrap_dog.Desc: Vines burst out and whip everything around four times.
flytrap_dog.Name: Vine Whip
flytrap_dog.Pt: Vinhas saem do chão e chicoteiam tudo em volta 4 vezes.

flytrap_dog.Desc: SUPREME: a giant flytrap swallows the enemy and the jungle grows around.
flytrap_dog.Name: JUNGLE DEVOUR
flytrap_dog.Pt: SUPREMO: uma planta carnívora gigante engole o inimigo e a selva cresce em volta.

frost_beast.Desc: Icicles grow on its back and launch at the enemy.
frost_beast.Name: Icicle Barrage
frost_beast.Pt: Pingentes de gelo crescem nas costas e são disparados.

frost_beast.Desc: Slams the ground: everything around freezes solid.
frost_beast.Name: Frozen Domain
frost_beast.Pt: Bate no chão: tudo em volta congela.

frost_beast.Desc: SUPREME: an eternal winter falls; giant icicles rain and everything freezes.
frost_beast.Name: ETERNAL WINTER
frost_beast.Pt: SUPREMO: inverno eterno; pingentes gigantes caem do céu e tudo congela.

frost_phoenix.Desc: Becomes an ice egg and heals; it cracks into a freezing storm and a volley of ice feathers flies where you aim.
frost_phoenix.Name: Glacial Rebirth
frost_phoenix.Pt: Vira um ovo de gelo e se cura; o ovo racha numa tempestade que congela e penas de gelo voam até a setinha.

frost_phoenix.Desc: Flaps its wings into a freezing blizzard.
frost_phoenix.Name: Blizzard Wings
frost_phoenix.Pt: Bate as asas e solta uma nevasca que congela.

frost_phoenix.Desc: SUPREME: a giant ice phoenix crosses the frozen sky and icicles rain down.
frost_phoenix.Name: FROZEN SKY
frost_phoenix.Pt: SUPREMO: uma fênix de gelo gigante cruza o céu congelado e caem pingentes.

galgo.Desc: Sprints through the enemy and back, leaving a wind tunnel.
galgo.Name: Slipstream
galgo.Pt: Corre atravessando o inimigo e volta (2 passadas) deixando um túnel de vento.

galgo.Desc: 3, 2, 1, GO! A rocket start that sends enemies flying.
galgo.Name: Starting Gate
galgo.Pt: Semáforo de corrida 3, 2, 1, GO! e uma largada foguete que joga o inimigo longe.

ghost_hound.Desc: Fades away and reappears behind the enemy with a critical bite.
ghost_hound.Name: Phase Bite
ghost_hound.Pt: Some, aparece atrás do inimigo e dá uma mordida crítica.

ghost_hound.Desc: Wails and little ghosts fly out to haunt and slow the enemies.
ghost_hound.Name: Haunting Wail
ghost_hound.Pt: Uiva assombrado e fantasminhas voam atrás dos inimigos, deixando lentos.

ghost_hound.Desc: SUPREME: night falls, ghosts rise from the ground and dive at enemies. BOO!
ghost_hound.Name: POLTERGEIST NIGHT
ghost_hound.Pt: SUPREMO: vira noite, fantasmas saem do chão e mergulham nos inimigos; termina com um BOO! gigante.

golden.Desc: Throws a tennis ball that bounces back; catching it heals a little.
golden.Name: Tennis Fetch
golden.Pt: Joga uma bolinha de tênis que bate e volta; pegar a bolinha cura um pouco.

golden.Desc: Sits happily and pulses warm light: damages around and heals.
golden.Name: Sunny Heart
golden.Pt: Senta feliz e solta 3 pulsos de luz dourada: machuca em volta e cura.

horned_pup.Desc: Charges, tosses the enemy up with its horns and rams it again.
horned_pup.Name: Horn Toss
horned_pup.Pt: Investe, joga o inimigo para cima com os chifres e dá outra chifrada quando ele cai.

horned_pup.Desc: Stomps and a stampede of spirit bulls charges through the enemy.
horned_pup.Name: Spirit Stampede
horned_pup.Pt: Pisa forte e uma manada de touros fantasmas atravessa o inimigo.

hydra_hound.Desc: The five heads stretch like snakes and bite from five sides. Every bite that lands heals.
hydra_hound.Name: Hydra Frenzy
hydra_hound.Pt: As 5 cabeças esticam como cobras e mordem a setinha de 5 lados; cada mordida que acerta cura.

hydra_hound.Desc: A wave of poisoned water crashes over the enemies.
hydra_hound.Name: Venom Tide
hydra_hound.Pt: Uma onda de água envenenada passa por cima dos inimigos.

hydra_hound.Desc: SUPREME: five giant serpent heads rise from the ground and strike. Heals.
hydra_hound.Name: HYDRA RISING
hydra_hound.Pt: SUPREMO: 5 cabeças de serpente gigantes saem do chão e atacam; cura.

inferno_hound.Desc: A ring of fire bursts out around it and burns.
inferno_hound.Name: Inferno Ring
inferno_hound.Pt: Um anel de fogo sai em volta dele e queima.

inferno_hound.Desc: Five pillars of fire erupt toward the enemy.
inferno_hound.Name: Hellfire Pillars
inferno_hound.Pt: 5 colunas de fogo estouram em fila até o inimigo.

inferno_hound.Desc: SUPREME: the ground turns to lava and a fire tornado rages.
inferno_hound.Name: INFERNO APOCALYPSE
inferno_hound.Pt: SUPREMO: o chão vira lava e um tornado de fogo aparece no inimigo.

knight_dog.Desc: Raises its shield and bashes the enemy, stunning it.
knight_dog.Name: Shield Bash
knight_dog.Pt: Levanta o escudo e dá uma escudada que atordoa.

knight_dog.Desc: Charges with a glowing lance and plants a pillar of light.
knight_dog.Name: Holy Lance
knight_dog.Pt: Investe com uma lança brilhante e finca uma coluna de luz.

knight_dog.Desc: SUPREME: a giant golden sword falls from the sky. Heals the knight.
knight_dog.Name: EXCALIBUR
knight_dog.Pt: SUPREMO: uma espada dourada gigante cai do céu no inimigo; cura o cavaleiro.

kraken_hound.Desc: Giant tentacles burst where you aim, lift enemies up and smash them down. Ends in a blast of ink.
kraken_hound.Name: Kraken Grab
kraken_hound.Pt: Tentáculos gigantes saem na setinha, levantam os inimigos e esmagam no chão; termina com tinta.

kraken_hound.Desc: A whirlpool pulls enemies in while tentacles slap them.
kraken_hound.Name: Whirlpool
kraken_hound.Pt: Um redemoinho puxa os inimigos enquanto tentáculos batem.

kraken_hound.Desc: SUPREME: eight giant tentacles rise and slam, then a tidal wave.
kraken_hound.Name: RELEASE THE KRAKEN
kraken_hound.Pt: SUPREMO: 8 tentáculos gigantes saem e batem um por um, depois uma onda gigante.

magma_hound.Desc: Spits three lava globs that leave burning pools.
magma_hound.Name: Lava Pools
magma_hound.Pt: Cospe 3 bolas de lava que viram poças de fogo.

magma_hound.Desc: Cracks the ground and lava geysers erupt in a line.
magma_hound.Name: Magma Burst
magma_hound.Pt: Racha o chão e gêiseres de lava estouram em linha até o inimigo.

magma_hound.Desc: SUPREME: a volcano rises under the enemy and erupts lava bombs.
magma_hound.Name: VOLCANO HEART
magma_hound.Pt: SUPREMO: um vulcão sobe do chão embaixo do inimigo e solta bombas de lava.

mecha_hound.Desc: Locks onto where you aim and fires a barrage of missiles, then a plasma cannon blast.
mecha_hound.Name: Missile Barrage
mecha_hound.Pt: Trava a mira na setinha e dispara mísseis; termina com o canhão de plasma.

mecha_hound.Desc: Charges its chest cannon and fires a massive photon beam.
mecha_hound.Name: Photon Cannon
mecha_hound.Pt: Carrega o canhão do peito e solta um raio de fótons enorme.

mecha_hound.Desc: SUPREME: targets locked — orbital lasers strike from space.
mecha_hound.Name: OMEGA PROTOCOL
mecha_hound.Pt: SUPREMO: miras travam nos inimigos e lasers caem do espaço.

mummy_dog.Desc: Shoots bandages that wrap the enemy up and pull it close.
mummy_dog.Name: Mummy Wrap
mummy_dog.Pt: Atira faixas que embrulham o inimigo (fica preso) e puxam para perto.

mummy_dog.Desc: A cursed sandstorm with scarabs: enemies take more damage.
mummy_dog.Name: Sandstorm Curse
mummy_dog.Pt: Tempestade de areia amaldiçoada com escaravelhos: os inimigos levam mais dano.

mummy_dog.Desc: SUPREME: a golden sarcophagus traps the enemy and explodes in light.
mummy_dog.Name: PHARAOH'S TOMB
mummy_dog.Pt: SUPREMO: um sarcófago dourado prende o inimigo, a areia cobre e explode em luz dourada.

mushroom_dog.Desc: A puff of sleepy spores puts the enemy to sleep.
mushroom_dog.Name: Sleepy Spores
mushroom_dog.Pt: Uma nuvem de esporos que faz o inimigo dormir.

mushroom_dog.Desc: A ring of mushrooms sprouts around the enemy and puffs poison.
mushroom_dog.Name: Fairy Ring
mushroom_dog.Pt: Um círculo de cogumelos brota em volta do inimigo e solta veneno 3 vezes.

ninja_dog.Desc: Throws five spinning shurikens in a fan.
ninja_dog.Name: Shuriken Fan

ninja_dog.Desc: Three shadow clones attack from three sides and vanish in smoke.
ninja_dog.Name: Shadow Clones
ninja_dog.Pt: 3 clones de sombra atacam de 3 lados e somem na fumaça.

ninja_dog.Desc: SUPREME: vanishes and strikes from every direction, then a final X cut.
ninja_dog.Name: THOUSAND SHADOWS
ninja_dog.Pt: SUPREMO: some e ataca de todos os lados, chuva de kunais e um corte em X no fim.

octopus_dog.Desc: Sprays a cloud of ink that slows and hurts.
octopus_dog.Name: Ink Cloud
octopus_dog.Pt: Solta uma nuvem de tinta que deixa lento e machuca.

octopus_dog.Desc: Four tentacles burst from the ground and slam down.
octopus_dog.Name: Tentacle Slam
octopus_dog.Pt: 4 tentáculos saem do chão e batem.

octopus_dog.Desc: SUPREME: a dark whirlpool pulls enemies into tentacles from the deep.
octopus_dog.Name: ABYSSAL WHIRLPOOL
octopus_dog.Pt: SUPREMO: um redemoinho escuro puxa os inimigos para os tentáculos do fundo do mar.

pastor_alemao.Desc: Locks on, leaps and pins the enemy down with bites.
pastor_alemao.Name: K9 Takedown
pastor_alemao.Pt: Fareja, a mira trava, salta e prende o inimigo no chão mordendo.

pastor_alemao.Desc: Police siren on! Red and blue bark waves end in a shocking zap.
pastor_alemao.Name: Siren Bark
pastor_alemao.Pt: Liga a sirene de polícia: latidos em ondas vermelhas e azuis e um choque que atordoa.

phoenix_hound.Desc: Wings ablaze, dives toward where you aim and explodes, leaving burning ground.
phoenix_hound.Name: Phoenix Dive
phoenix_hound.Pt: Asas em chamas, mergulha na direção da setinha e explode; o chão fica pegando fogo.

phoenix_hound.Desc: Circles high above the enemy and dives like a meteor, leaving the ground ablaze.
phoenix_hound.Name: Firestorm Dive
phoenix_hound.Pt: Voa em círculo acima do inimigo e mergulha como meteoro; o chão fica pegando fogo.

phoenix_hound.Desc: SUPREME: a giant fire phoenix sweeps the sky and burning feathers rain down.
phoenix_hound.Name: PHOENIX SKYFALL
phoenix_hound.Pt: SUPREMO: uma fênix de fogo gigante cruza o céu e penas de fogo caem; cura.

pinscher.Desc: Trembles, zips in for two quick nips and zips back.
pinscher.Name: Nervous Nip
pinscher.Pt: Treme de nervoso, dispara até o inimigo, dá 2 mordidinhas e volta correndo.

pinscher.Desc: Spins so fast it makes a little tornado that runs into the enemy.
pinscher.Name: Tiny Twister
pinscher.Pt: Gira tão rápido que solta um tornadinho que vai até o inimigo e empurra.

pirate_dog.Desc: Throws its anchor, hooks the enemy and pulls it in.
pirate_dog.Name: Anchor Hook
pirate_dog.Pt: Joga a âncora, engancha o inimigo e puxa para perto.

pirate_dog.Desc: Cannonballs fly in from the sea around the enemy.
pirate_dog.Name: Cannon Barrage
pirate_dog.Pt: Balas de canhão chegam do mar em volta do inimigo.

pirate_dog.Desc: SUPREME: a ghost ship sails through, fires a broadside and a giant wave.
pirate_dog.Name: GHOST SHIP
pirate_dog.Pt: SUPREMO: um navio pirata fantasma passa atirando todos os canhões e solta uma onda gigante.

planet_hound.Desc: The moon leaves orbit and crashes where you aim; its rings become a shockwave.
planet_hound.Name: Moonfall
planet_hound.Pt: A lua sai da órbita e cai na setinha; os anéis viram uma onda de choque.

planet_hound.Desc: Flowers bloom, water geysers burst and vines hold the enemies.
planet_hound.Name: World Bloom
planet_hound.Pt: Flores brotam, gêiseres de água estouram e vinhas prendem os inimigos.

planet_hound.Desc: SUPREME: a whole planet falls from the sky, oceans and jungles follow.
planet_hound.Name: LIVING PLANET
planet_hound.Pt: SUPREMO: um planeta inteiro cai do céu; depois vem o oceano e a selva.

poodle.Desc: A fancy pirouette that throws pom-poms all around.
poodle.Name: Pom-Pom Pirouette
poodle.Pt: Faz uma pirueta chique e solta pompons para todo lado.

poodle.Desc: Blows a pink perfume breeze that charms enemies for a moment.
poodle.Name: Perfume Breeze
poodle.Pt: Sopra uma brisa de perfume rosa com coraçõezinhos que encanta (para) o inimigo.

pug.Desc: Hops up and lands belly-first on the enemy. BONK!
pug.Name: Belly Flop
pug.Pt: Dá um pulinho e cai de barriga em cima do inimigo (BONK!).

pug.Desc: Lies down and snores so loud the ground shakes. The last snore puts enemies to sleep.
pug.Name: Snore Quake
pug.Pt: Deita e ronca 3 vezes; cada ronco faz o chão tremer e o último dá sono.

rainbow_unicorn.Desc: A rainbow forms toward where you aim; it gallops across and lands horn-first in a burst of color.
rainbow_unicorn.Name: Rainbow Bridge
rainbow_unicorn.Pt: Um arco-íris nasce até a setinha; galopa por cima e cai com o chifre numa explosão de cores.

rainbow_unicorn.Desc: Fires three rainbow beams in a fan.
rainbow_unicorn.Name: Prism Burst
rainbow_unicorn.Pt: Solta 3 raios de arco-íris em leque.

rainbow_unicorn.Desc: SUPREME: a rainbow sky and a downpour of colorful stars. Heals.
rainbow_unicorn.Name: RAINBOW DELUGE
rainbow_unicorn.Pt: SUPREMO: céu de arco-íris e chuva de estrelas coloridas; cura.

robo_dog.Desc: Fires a red laser from its eyes and sweeps it across.
robo_dog.Name: Laser Sweep
robo_dog.Pt: Laser vermelho dos olhos varrendo de um lado para o outro.

robo_dog.Desc: Its back opens and six mini missiles rain on the enemy.
robo_dog.Name: Mini Missiles
robo_dog.Pt: As costas abrem e 6 mini mísseis caem em volta do inimigo.

saber_dog.Desc: Pounces and slashes with its saber fangs, making the enemy bleed.
saber_dog.Name: Saber Maul
saber_dog.Pt: Dá o bote e corta com os dentes de sabre; o inimigo sangra.

saber_dog.Desc: A freezing roar that turns enemies into ice.
saber_dog.Name: Ice Age Roar
saber_dog.Pt: Um rugido congelante que transforma o inimigo em gelo.

saber_dog.Desc: SUPREME: glaciers rise and a giant sabertooth spirit leaps through.
saber_dog.Name: EXTINCTION
saber_dog.Pt: SUPREMO: geleiras sobem e um espírito gigante de dente-de-sabre atravessa tudo.

salsicha.Desc: Throws a hot dog that bounces twice on the enemy.
salsicha.Name: Hot Dog Toss
salsicha.Pt: Joga um cachorro-quente que quica 2 vezes (acerta 3 vezes).

salsicha.Desc: Digs a tunnel under the enemy and pops out launching it up.
salsicha.Name: Tunnel Pop
salsicha.Pt: Cava um túnel, o chão racha até o inimigo e ele sai do chão jogando o inimigo para cima.

samurai_shiba.Desc: A lightning-fast draw: dashes through the enemy and the cut lands a moment later.
samurai_shiba.Name: Iaijutsu
samurai_shiba.Pt: Saque relâmpago: atravessa o inimigo e o corte aparece um instante depois.

samurai_shiba.Desc: Spins its katana in a storm of cherry petals.
samurai_shiba.Name: Sakura Storm
samurai_shiba.Pt: Gira a katana numa tempestade de pétalas de cerejeira.

samurai_shiba.Desc: SUPREME: the sky darkens, dozens of cuts appear around the enemy and all strike at once.
samurai_shiba.Name: THOUSAND CUTS
samurai_shiba.Pt: SUPREMO: o céu escurece, dezenas de cortes aparecem em volta do inimigo e cortam todos juntos.

sao_bernardo.Desc: Throws its rescue barrel; it bursts in snow and the hot cocoa heals it.
sao_bernardo.Name: Rescue Barrel
sao_bernardo.Pt: Joga o barrilzinho de resgate; estoura em neve e o chocolate quente cura.

sao_bernardo.Desc: Slams the ground and a giant snowball rolls over enemies.
sao_bernardo.Name: Avalanche Ball
sao_bernardo.Pt: Bate no chão e solta uma bola de neve gigante que rola por cima dos inimigos.

scorpion_dog.Desc: Strikes with its tail stinger and poisons.
scorpion_dog.Name: Stinger
scorpion_dog.Pt: Ferroada com o rabo de escorpião que envenena.

scorpion_dog.Desc: A sand pit opens under the enemy, pulling it in and poisoning.
scorpion_dog.Name: Toxic Sands
scorpion_dog.Pt: Abre um buraco de areia que puxa o inimigo e envenena.

scorpion_dog.Desc: SUPREME: a giant scorpion tail rises from the sand and stabs three times.
scorpion_dog.Name: DESERT KING
scorpion_dog.Pt: SUPREMO: um rabo de escorpião gigante sai da areia e ferroa 3 vezes.

seraph_hound.Desc: Spreads its six wings: pillars of light surround where you aim and close into a holy column. Heals a little.
seraph_hound.Name: Divine Judgement
seraph_hound.Pt: Abre as 6 asas: colunas de luz cercam a setinha e fecham numa coluna sagrada; cura um pouco.

seraph_hound.Desc: Its six wings unleash a storm of razor-sharp golden feathers.
seraph_hound.Name: Feather Storm
seraph_hound.Pt: As 6 asas soltam uma tempestade de penas douradas cortantes.

seraph_hound.Desc: SUPREME: the gates of heaven open and holy spears rain down. Heals.
seraph_hound.Name: HEAVEN'S GATE
seraph_hound.Pt: SUPREMO: o portão do céu abre e lanças sagradas caem; cura.

shadow_cerberus.Desc: A hell portal opens where you aim: three spectral heads bite and shadow spikes launch enemies.
shadow_cerberus.Name: Hell Gate
shadow_cerberus.Pt: Um portal do inferno abre na setinha: 3 cabeças espectrais mordem e espinhos de sombra jogam os inimigos para cima.

shadow_cerberus.Desc: The three heads breathe shadow fire in three directions, spinning.
shadow_cerberus.Name: Triple Inferno
shadow_cerberus.Pt: As 3 cabeças soltam fogo de sombra em 3 direções girando; queima.

shadow_cerberus.Desc: SUPREME: the sky burns red and three hellhounds hunt the enemies down.
shadow_cerberus.Name: HELLHOUND PACK
shadow_cerberus.Pt: SUPREMO: o céu fica vermelho e 3 cães do inferno caçam os inimigos e explodem.

shadow_doberman.Desc: Melts into a shadow, slides under the enemy and bursts out biting.
shadow_doberman.Name: Shadow Step
shadow_doberman.Pt: Vira sombra, desliza até embaixo do inimigo e sai mordendo para cima.

shadow_doberman.Desc: Four nightmare clones rush in from all sides and explode.
shadow_doberman.Name: Nightmare Clones
shadow_doberman.Pt: 4 clones de pesadelo correm de todos os lados e explodem.

shadow_doberman.Desc: SUPREME: total darkness and bites from everywhere, then a critical strike.
shadow_doberman.Name: ETERNAL NIGHT
shadow_doberman.Pt: SUPREMO: escuridão total, mordidas de todos os lados e um golpe crítico no fim.

shark_dog.Desc: Dives into the ground like water and bursts out biting.
shark_dog.Name: Fin Dive
shark_dog.Pt: Mergulha no chão como se fosse água, só a barbatana aparece, e sai mordendo.

shark_dog.Desc: Circles the enemy with its fin, then bites from three sides.
shark_dog.Name: Feeding Frenzy
shark_dog.Pt: Nada em volta do inimigo com a barbatana e morde de 3 lados.

shark_dog.Desc: SUPREME: a giant shark bursts from the ground and chomps everything.
shark_dog.Name: MEGALODON
shark_dog.Pt: SUPREMO: um tubarão gigante sai do chão e abocanha tudo, com onda em volta.

singularity_pup.Desc: A black hole forms where you aim, grinds enemies in orbit and spits them far away through a white hole.
singularity_pup.Name: Event Horizon
singularity_pup.Pt: Um buraco negro nasce na setinha, tritura em órbita e cospe longe num buraco branco.

singularity_pup.Desc: Lifts the enemies into the air and crushes them into the ground.
singularity_pup.Name: Gravity Crush
singularity_pup.Pt: Levanta os inimigos no ar e esmaga no chão.

singularity_pup.Desc: SUPREME: a supermassive black hole pulls everything in and bursts in white light.
singularity_pup.Name: SUPERMASSIVE
singularity_pup.Pt: SUPREMO: um buraco negro gigante puxa tudo e explode em luz branca.

skull_dog.Desc: Throws a spinning bone that hits on the way out and on the way back.
skull_dog.Name: Boomerang Bone
skull_dog.Pt: Joga um osso que gira, acerta na ida e na volta.

skull_dog.Desc: Rattles its ribs: bones burst from the ground and curse the enemy.
skull_dog.Name: Bone Rattle
skull_dog.Pt: Chacoalha as costelas: ossos saem do chão em volta do inimigo e ele fica amaldiçoado (leva mais dano).

snow_husky.Desc: Slides on its belly leaving an ice trail. Enemies hit are slowed.
snow_husky.Name: Sled Dash
snow_husky.Pt: Escorrega de barriga como trenó deixando um rastro de gelo; quem é atingido fica lento.

snow_husky.Desc: Howls up a small blizzard on the enemy that ends in a freeze.
snow_husky.Name: Snowstorm Howl
snow_husky.Pt: Uiva e faz uma nevasca no inimigo; no fim congela.

stone_hound.Desc: Rips a boulder from the ground and throws it.
stone_hound.Name: Boulder Toss
stone_hound.Pt: Arranca uma pedra enorme do chão e arremessa.

stone_hound.Desc: Covers itself in rocks and rolls through enemies twice, then bursts them.
stone_hound.Name: Rock Armor Roll
stone_hound.Pt: Se cobre de pedras, vira bola, rola 2 vezes pelos inimigos e explode as pedras.

storm_pup.Desc: Zigzags around the enemy leaving lightning, then strikes and shocks.
storm_pup.Name: Thunder Hunt
storm_pup.Pt: Corre em zigue-zague em volta do inimigo deixando raios e termina com um golpe que dá choque.

storm_pup.Desc: A storm cloud over the enemy drops four lightning bolts.
storm_pup.Name: Static Storm
storm_pup.Pt: Uma nuvem de tempestade em cima do inimigo solta 4 raios (cada um dá choque).

storm_wolf.Desc: An electric bite that chains lightning to nearby enemies.
storm_wolf.Name: Thunder Fang
storm_wolf.Pt: Mordida elétrica e o raio pula para os inimigos perto.

storm_wolf.Desc: Howls up a cyclone with lightning around the enemy.
storm_wolf.Name: Howling Tempest
storm_wolf.Pt: Uiva e cria um ciclone com raios em volta do inimigo.

storm_wolf.Desc: SUPREME: a storm brings four lightning wolves that hunt the enemies.
storm_wolf.Name: WOLF PACK STORM
storm_wolf.Pt: SUPREMO: uma tempestade traz 4 lobos de raio que caçam os inimigos.

sun_dragon.Desc: A sweeping beam of golden sunfire toward where you aim, then a small sun crashes there. Heals.
sun_dragon.Name: Sunfire Breath
sun_dragon.Pt: Raio de fogo solar dourado varrendo na direção da setinha; um pequeno sol cai lá e explode; cura.

sun_dragon.Desc: Wings ablaze, dives through the enemy and bursts in a solar flare. Heals.
sun_dragon.Name: Solar Wings
sun_dragon.Pt: Asas em chamas, mergulha atravessando o inimigo e explode numa erupção solar; cura.

sun_dragon.Desc: SUPREME: a sun descends from the sky, sweeps with solar rays and goes supernova.
sun_dragon.Name: DIVINE SUNFIRE
sun_dragon.Pt: SUPREMO: um sol desce do céu, varre tudo com raios solares e explode em supernova; cura.

tank_dog.Desc: Fires a heavy cannon shell that explodes.
tank_dog.Name: Tank Shell
tank_dog.Pt: Dispara um projétil de canhão que explode.

tank_dog.Desc: Six artillery shells rain on marked spots.
tank_dog.Name: Heavy Artillery
tank_dog.Pt: 6 bombas de artilharia caem nos pontos marcados.

tank_dog.Desc: SUPREME: bomber planes fly over and drop a line of bombs.
tank_dog.Name: CARPET BOMB
tank_dog.Pt: SUPREMO: aviões bombardeiros passam e soltam uma fila de bombas.

thunder_colossus.Desc: Three stomps: each sends a wall of lightning marching to where you aim. The last one shocks.
thunder_colossus.Name: Thunder Wall
thunder_colossus.Pt: 3 pisadas: cada uma solta um muro de raios que marcha até a setinha; o último dá choque.

thunder_colossus.Desc: A giant fist of lightning falls from the sky on the enemy.
thunder_colossus.Name: Storm Fist
thunder_colossus.Pt: Um punho gigante de raio cai do céu no inimigo; dá choque.

thunder_colossus.Desc: SUPREME: lightning strikes everywhere for three seconds while the ground shakes.
thunder_colossus.Name: STORM TITAN
thunder_colossus.Pt: SUPREMO: raios caem por toda parte por 3 segundos e o chão treme.

titan_mastiff.Desc: Roars and becomes a TITAN for a few seconds (bigger, stronger, every bite quakes); golden cracks race to where you aim.
titan_mastiff.Name: Titan Rage
titan_mastiff.Pt: Urra e vira TITÃ por alguns segundos (cresce, bate mais forte, cada mordida treme o chão); rachaduras douradas correm até a setinha.

titan_mastiff.Desc: Leaps and lands on all fours: golden cracks race forward and launch enemies.
titan_mastiff.Name: Titan Stomp
titan_mastiff.Pt: Pula e cai com as 4 patas: rachaduras douradas correm para a frente jogando os inimigos para cima.

titan_mastiff.Desc: SUPREME: golden pillars surround the enemy and a giant fist smashes down.
titan_mastiff.Name: TITAN'S JUDGMENT
titan_mastiff.Pt: SUPREMO: colunas douradas cercam o inimigo e um punho gigante cai do céu.

toxic_hound.Desc: Spits three acid globs that leave burning puddles.
toxic_hound.Name: Acid Spit
toxic_hound.Pt: Cospe 3 bolas de ácido que deixam poças que queimam.

toxic_hound.Desc: Breathes a huge toxic cloud that poisons and slows.
toxic_hound.Name: Toxic Cloud
toxic_hound.Pt: Solta uma nuvem tóxica enorme que envenena e deixa lento.

toxic_hound.Desc: SUPREME: the sky turns green and toxic geysers erupt everywhere.
toxic_hound.Name: TOXIC FLOOD
toxic_hound.Pt: SUPREMO: o céu fica verde e gêiseres de veneno estouram por toda parte.

twin_fang.Desc: The dark and light heads take turns biting; the last bite is critical.
twin_fang.Name: Double Assault
twin_fang.Pt: As 2 cabeças (sombra e luz) mordem alternando; a última é crítica.

twin_fang.Desc: A light orb and a dark orb orbit, then crash together over the enemy.
twin_fang.Name: Eclipse
twin_fang.Pt: Uma bola de luz e uma de sombra giram e se chocam em cima do inimigo.

twin_fang.Desc: SUPREME: pillars of light and shadow fall in turns, then a total eclipse.
twin_fang.Name: TWILIGHT JUDGMENT
twin_fang.Pt: SUPREMO: colunas de luz e sombra caem alternadas e no fim um eclipse total; cura.

velocity_hound.Desc: Breaks the sound barrier dashing through the enemy.
velocity_hound.Name: Sonic Rush
velocity_hound.Pt: Quebra a barreira do som atravessando o inimigo.

velocity_hound.Desc: Five zigzag dashes leave lightning that explodes.
velocity_hound.Name: Storm Rush
velocity_hound.Pt: 5 arrancadas em zigue-zague deixam raios que explodem.

velocity_hound.Desc: SUPREME: runs circles so fast a lightning tornado forms, then a hyper dash.
velocity_hound.Name: LIGHTSPEED
velocity_hound.Pt: SUPREMO: corre em círculos tão rápido que forma um tornado de raios e termina com uma hiper arrancada.

void_beast.Desc: A black hole opens where you aim, pulls everyone in and implodes.
void_beast.Name: Void Rift
void_beast.Pt: Um buraco negro abre na setinha, puxa todo mundo para o centro e implode.

void_beast.Desc: Its third eye charges and fires a void beam that pierces and slows.
void_beast.Name: Third Eye Beam
void_beast.Pt: O 3º olho carrega e solta um raio do vazio que atravessa e deixa lento.

void_beast.Desc: SUPREME: a giant void mouth opens under the enemies and chomps shut.
void_beast.Name: ABYSS MAW
void_beast.Pt: SUPREMO: uma boca gigante do vazio abre embaixo dos inimigos e fecha mordendo.

werewolf_dog.Desc: A frenzy of five claw slashes.
werewolf_dog.Name: Lunar Fury

werewolf_dog.Desc: A full moon rises; its howl makes it stronger and scares enemies.
werewolf_dog.Name: Moon Howl
werewolf_dog.Pt: Aparece a lua cheia; o uivo deixa ele mais forte e assusta os inimigos.

werewolf_dog.Desc: SUPREME: a blood moon rises and three giant claw slashes rip the ground.
werewolf_dog.Name: BLOOD MOON
werewolf_dog.Pt: SUPREMO: lua de sangue e 3 garradas gigantes rasgam o chão.

windup_dog.Desc: Its key winds up and it zooms around like a toy, sparking.
windup_dog.Name: Wind-Up Rush
windup_dog.Pt: A chave nas costas dá corda e ele sai correndo em zigue-zague como brinquedo, soltando faíscas.

windup_dog.Desc: Boings on the enemy three times with electric sparks.
windup_dog.Name: Spring Bounce
windup_dog.Pt: Pula como mola em cima do inimigo 3 vezes com faíscas elétricas.

wizard_dog.Desc: Three orbs of fire, ice and lightning orbit and fire at the enemy.
wizard_dog.Name: Arcane Orbs
wizard_dog.Pt: 3 orbes (fogo, gelo e raio) giram em volta e são lançados (queima, deixa lento e dá choque).

wizard_dog.Desc: Pillars of fire, ice and lightning surround the enemy and merge.
wizard_dog.Name: Elemental Trinity
wizard_dog.Pt: Colunas de fogo, gelo e raio cercam o inimigo e se juntam numa explosão.

wizard_dog.Desc: SUPREME: a giant magic circle casts meteors, blizzard and lightning at once.
wizard_dog.Name: GRAND SPELLBOOK
wizard_dog.Pt: SUPREMO: um círculo mágico gigante solta meteoros, nevasca e raios juntos.

yeti_dog.Desc: Lifts a huge snow boulder and throws it.
yeti_dog.Name: Avalanche Toss
yeti_dog.Pt: Levanta uma bola de neve gigante e arremessa.

yeti_dog.Desc: Stomps and ice shards erupt in a cross.
yeti_dog.Name: Glacier Quake
yeti_dog.Pt: Pisa e lascas de gelo e pedra estouram em cruz.

yeti_dog.Desc: SUPREME: a roaring blizzard and giant ice fists slam from the sky.
yeti_dog.Name: ABOMINABLE BLIZZARD
yeti_dog.Pt: SUPREMO: nevasca rugindo e punhos de gelo gigantes caem do céu.
